description: This file defines a PHP class LicenseFileAPI that provides an API endpoint for retrieving the contents of the LICENSE file in the OrangeHRM installer module.

classes.name: LicenseFileAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that handles GET requests to serve the contents of the LICENSE file.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the LICENSE file contents, returning it as part of an array.
